name: omentir__remote-mcp
description: Hosted MCP server for Omentir, an open-source AI sales workspace for LinkedIn. An agent can find and score LinkedIn prospects, draft outreach, run human-paced campaigns with daily limits, and answer replies.
long_description: Omentir gives AI assistants a workspace-scoped lead-discovery and outreach interface. Use it to configure lead finders, inspect qualified LinkedIn leads, run or stop queued sends, read the live LinkedIn inbox, and reply in existing threads without exposing LinkedIn passwords.
instructions: Connect via OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE, or enter a workspace-scoped Bearer token from Settings -> API keys at https://omentir.com/api-keys.

oauth_config.name: Omentir
oauth_config.description: Omentir MCP Server (OAuth 2.1 with dynamic registration)

tools.name: omentir_get_context
tools.description: Read workspace readiness, product profile, setup status, counts, owned workspaces, API resources, the workspace time zone, and how much of today

tools.name: omentir_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces the token owner already has, and mark which one this token is bound to.

tools.name: omentir_switch_workspace
tools.description: Rebind this Bearer token to another owned workspace. Later MCP and REST calls on the same token hit that workspace. Cannot create or delete a workspace.

tools.name: omentir_get_stats
tools.description: Read the Overview headline metrics. Optional range (all/7d/30d/3m/month) windows invites and messages the same way the dashboard picker does.

tools.name: omentir_get_product_profile
tools.description: Read the workspace product profile used for ICP matching and outreach personalization.

tools.name: omentir_update_product_profile
tools.description: Update the workspace product profile used to qualify and rank discovered leads. Also sets the workspace demo booking link (schedulingLink) used by continue-until-booked outreach.

tools.name: omentir_list_agents
tools.description: List Omentir agents in the token workspace (classic lead finders, outreach-only, and Steal Customers / steal_customers), including each one

tools.name: omentir_create_agent
tools.description: Create an agent. Classic: prompt + filters; optional setupOutreach, custom steps, tone, campaignGoal. Steal Customers: groupName + competitor/founder URLs; AI outreach automatic. Outreach-only: mode=outreach plus optional csvContents and steps. Returns agent + leadGroup.

tools.name: omentir_update_agent
tools.description: Update any agent: targeting, outreach sequence (steps, tone, campaignGoal), reply policy, send window, or status. A leads-only agent can gain outreach when setupOutreach or steps is set. Steal Customers still rejects manual templates. Only provided fields change.

tools.name: omentir_update_settings
tools.description: Update workspace outreach settings: daily connection-request and message limits, first-message delay, AI follow-up behaviour, and the workspace time zone that daily limit resets are measured in. Only provided fields change.

tools.name: omentir_list_leads
tools.description: Search, filter, sort, and list discovered leads, optionally within one lead group. Steal Customers leads include signalText, leadReason, and engagementContext (post text, post URL, comment text, comment URL) for outreach context.

tools.name: omentir_get_lead
tools.description: Get the complete workspace-owned lead record for an exact lead id, including engagementContext for Steal Customers leads (post text, post URL, comment text, comment URL) plus profile and fit score.

tools.name: omentir_list_conversations
tools.description: List LinkedIn reply threads captured by Omentir. Filter with the same Messages tabs (all/successful/booked/interested/follow/denied) and optional text search.

tools.name: omentir_list_groups
tools.description: List lead groups in the token workspace.

tools.name: omentir_list_linkedin_accounts
tools.description: List connected LinkedIn accounts available to lead-finding agents.

tools.name: omentir_list_activity
tools.description: List recent automation activity runs (the workspace activity feed).

tools.name: omentir_list_scheduled_actions
tools.description: List upcoming outreach in send order with each action

tools.name: omentir_pause_agent
tools.description: Pause an agent: stops its lead discovery and freezes all automated outreach (connection requests, follow-ups, AI replies) to the leads it sourced.

tools.name: omentir_resume_agent
tools.description: Resume a paused agent: lead discovery runs again on the next tick and its frozen outreach is woken immediately.

tools.name: omentir_delete_agent
tools.description: Delete an agent permanently: stops all outreach to the leads it sourced and deletes its lead group and the campaigns contacting that group (unless another agent uses the same group). Leads in that group are permanently deleted.

tools.name: omentir_reply_to_lead
tools.description: Reply to a lead in an existing LinkedIn conversation. This cannot start a new conversation and counts against the daily message quota.

tools.name: omentir_draft_agent_setup
tools.description: Fill-with-AI for a new agent: titles, industries, locations, keywords, prompt, and starter message templates from Workspace. Does not create the agent.

tools.name: omentir_analyze_website
tools.description: Fetch a website and write the Workspace product profile from it (same as AI Analyse on Workspace).

tools.name: omentir_import_csv_leads
tools.description: Import LinkedIn profile URLs from CSV into an outreach-only agent.

tools.name: omentir_export_leads
tools.description: Export one lead group as CSV (same columns as the Leads download).

tools.name: omentir_delete_group
tools.description: Delete a lead group that no agent or campaign still uses. Delete or reassign the agent first if this fails.

tools.name: omentir_run_scheduled_action_now
tools.description: Send the next queued outreach action for an enrollment immediately (Send now on Leads / Actions).

tools.name: omentir_stop_lead_outreach
tools.description: Stop automated outreach for one lead. Already-sent invites and messages stay.

tools.name: omentir_list_inbox
tools.description: List live LinkedIn DM threads from connected seats (the Messages inbox, not only Omentir-captured replies).

tools.name: omentir_get_chat_messages
tools.description: Load older messages for one live LinkedIn chat. Pass the cursor from the previous page.

tools.name: omentir_reply_to_chat
tools.description: Reply in a live LinkedIn chat, optionally with attachments (base64, 15MB each). Counts against the daily message quota and the 5-minute send slot.

tools.name: omentir_complete_follow_up
tools.description: Mark a manual follow-up done on a conversation (same as Messages).
